jobs.description:
OFCI Manager - Data Center Projects
📍 Location: Stockholm, Sweden
🏢 Department: PMO (Project Management Office)
🚀 Experience Level: Intermediate to Senior
We're looking for an OFCI Manager to join our PMO team in Stockholm and play a central role in delivering large-scale data center projects across Sweden.
In this role, you'll lead the planning, coordination, and installation readiness of Owner Furnished Contractor Installed (OFCI) equipment, ensuring critical infrastructure is delivered and installed safely, efficiently, and on schedule. Working closely with clients, suppliers, logistics partners, and construction teams, you'll help drive successful project delivery from procurement through commissioning and handover.
This position is based in Stockholm, with occasional travel to project sites as required.
What You'll Do
As OFCI Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring that owner-supplied equipment arrives where it needs to be, when it needs to be there, and is ready for installation without impacting project delivery.
Your responsibilities will include:

Owning and maintaining the OFCI schedule, aligning equipment deliveries with construction, commissioning, and handover milestones

Coordinating between client procurement teams, equipment vendors, logistics partners, and installation contractors

Managing the OFCI register, including purchase orders, lead times, delivery schedules, storage plans, and installation status

Planning equipment receiving, inspections, and damage/shortage reporting processes

Defining installation scopes and managing interfaces between owners, suppliers, and contractors

Ensuring installation resources are available when equipment arrives on site

Tracking delays, changes, risks, and claims, and escalating issues proactively

Supporting commissioning activities (L1-L5), warranty management, as-built documentation, and project handover

Providing regular progress updates and reporting to project leadership and clients

Intermediate Level
At the intermediate level, you will:

Own the OFCI scope for a defined package or project site

Coordinate stakeholders and manage day-to-day delivery activities

Drive planning and execution with support on major escalations and contractual interfaces

Build expertise in data center delivery and critical infrastructure projects

Senior Level
At the senior level, you will:

Lead OFCI delivery across multiple project packages or sites

Establish and improve OFCI processes, standards, and reporting structures

Manage senior client stakeholders, key vendors, and complex project interfaces

Mentor colleagues and contribute to the growth of the wider PMO organization

Act as a trusted advisor on OFCI strategy, risk management, and execution planning

What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in data center, critical infrastructure, industrial, or large-scale construction project delivery (intermediate level)

7+ years of relevant experience for senior-level candidates

Experience working with OFCI/CFCI procurement models and contractor interfaces

Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems and commissioning processes

Experience in logistics, supply chain coordination, and vendor management

Proficiency with project scheduling and tracking tools such as MS Project, Primavera, and Excel

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Fluent English, both written and spoken

Nice to Have

Fluency in Swedish

Experience delivering hyperscale or colocation data center projects

Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and site safety practices

PMP or equivalent project management certification

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of Sweden's rapidly growing data center sector, delivering business-critical infrastructure for global clients. You'll collaborate with experienced project professionals, influence project outcomes, and take ownership of a highly visible function that directly impacts project success.
Whether you're looking to take the next step in your career or bring your senior expertise to complex mission-critical projects, you'll find challenging work, significant responsibility, and opportunities for long-term growth.
Ready to make an impact?
Apply today and help us deliver the next generation of mission-critical data center infrastructure.
About Barona
Barona is an international group with operations in 10 countries. In Sweden, we have offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Falun, and Strömsund, providing talent and workforce solutions to clients across the country. 
We offer our clients a forward-thinking, future-oriented partnership and provide our employees with exciting career opportunities at every stage of their professional journey. Since our foundation in Finland in 1999, our success has been built on a strong customer focus and an innovative approach to service offerings and business development. Through our commitment to innovation and digitalization, we remain at the forefront of modern recruitment.
Learn more about Barona:
https://barona.se/om-barona/

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.  

Your opportunity 

Do you want to take ownership of business-critical server infrastructure in a high-tech industrial environment? As our IT Service Specialist in Aitik, you will help ensure stable, secure and efficient IT services while contributing to future-ready infrastructure solutions. This is a varied specialist role with significant responsibility, technical breadth and the opportunity to make a visible impact on daily operations. 

Who you will work with 

You will be part of Aitik's local IT organisation, a group of approximately ten colleagues. Collaboration extends across local IT disciplines, central specialist teams, other Boliden sites and external suppliers. The team shares knowledge and works across boundaries. 

What you will do 

You will be responsible for the operation and lifecycle of the Aitik server environment. Your work will include: 

Operating, administering, maintaining, installing, and upgrading server environments, Windows/Linux. 

Working with Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualisation, storage, backup and physical server hardware. 

Supporting secure infrastructure design, system segmentation, and implementation of new systems. 

Handling incidents, troubleshooting technical issues, and contributing to root cause analysis. 

Planning capacity, monitoring performance and improving availability, resilience, and recovery capability. 

Driving continuous improvement through automation, standardisation and clear technical documentation. 

Working with suppliers and internal stakeholders to turn different requirements into secure, practical, and maintainable solutions. 

 

What you bring 

You have several years of hands-on experience in server operations and infrastructure and can quickly understand an existing environment, set priorities and work independently. You are comfortable taking responsibility for delivery, while knowing when to involve colleagues or central specialists. You combine analytical problem solving with a structured and security-conscious approach. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you communicate clearly with technical specialists, suppliers, and other stakeholders. You are curious, proactive and motivated by continuous improvement. 

Completed upper-secondary education. Relevant post-secondary IT education is an advantage. 
Several years of experience in server operation and infrastructure. 

Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory, including Group Policy. 

Experience of virtualisation platforms such as VMware and/or Hyper-V, as well as storage and backup solutions. 

Experience in IT security, infrastructure architecture, and secure implementation of systems. 

Professional proficiency in spoken and written English. 

A valid category B driving license for manual transmission. 

Experience from agile ways of working, automation, PowerShell, Azure or hybrid environments is considered an advantage. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, is considered an advantage. Cisco or other relevant vendor certifications are also an advantage. Swedish language skills are beneficial but not required. 

Why work with us 

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world. 

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful! 

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential. 

 

Want to know more about the position? Contact Head of IT Aitik Lill.vonBorck@boliden.com or Head of Mines Infrastructure Ted.Lindholm@boliden.com .  

Questions about the application are answered by our Talent Acquisition Partner, emma.bystedt@boliden.com  

For union information, please contact: unionen.aitik@boliden.com 

 

Location: Aitik, Gällivare  

Last day to apply: 15th of November 

As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, background checks may be included in the recruitment process. 

 

If you are a representative of a recruiting company, please refrain from contacting us about this advertisement. We appreciate your consideration.

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Parts and Services - Central & Northern Europe / Normet
jobs.description:
Normet is now seeking a Sales Manager to drive parts and services revenue growth and manage key customer relationships across the European mining and tunneling sector. If you are an expert within the mining sector and sales, love to travel and eager to take the next challenge in your career, don't hesitate to apply!
About the role
The Sales Manager serves as the primary point of contact for customers and is responsible for driving parts and services sales and revenue growth by maintaining and expanding existing accounts. As an active account management team member, you need to pay special attention to inventory planning, parts consumption, training, and service requirements at the mine and tunneling site level.
What we offer?
Key role in industry growth: A pivotal position driving Normet’s parts and services expansion across the European mining and tunneling sector.
International environment & dynamic travel: Work with diverse European clients and cross-functional teams, traveling up to 75% to key customer sites in central- and northern Europe.
Impact & ownership: Full accountability for key account planning, TCO modeling, and developing tailored customer solutions.
Collaborative culture: Close synergy with Service, Equipment Sales, and technical support teams across local and international offices.

Work tasks
Key responsibilities involve
Business Growth and Functional
Execution of the sales strategy for parts and services, growth within current and new customer base; responsible for leading and delivering on customer-specific monthly revenue targets.
Active management in customer planning with spare parts, consumption levels, and portfolio offerings available within Normet. Identify gaps in customer purchasing behavior and work to create solutions to penetrate new sales.
Active involvement with recommended spare parts kits and total cost of ownership modeling, pursuit of rental and used equipment opportunities.
Lead on-site review meetings (monthly/quarterly as needed) with regular site visits and interactions.
Address technical inquiries, on-site spare parts management reviews with recommended adjustments, review equipment performance and identify upgrades.
Provide feedback for engineering and production regarding quality, parts reliability, and service with an understanding of bringing forward the voice of the customer.
Active sales opportunity pipeline and customer fleet data management within Normet systems.

Financials
Assist with forecasting, aligned with expected growth and actual order intake.
Responsible for developing and executing the sales plan in a profitable and accountable fashion.
Follow up on accounts receivables of orders as required.

Collaboration and Customer Relations
Proactive customer focus to positively support the growth of Normet.
Work alongside with Service Manager and Service teams to manage regional accounts.
Coordinate with the local / international Normet order processing and technical teams.
Collaborate closely with the Equipment Sales team throughout the sales process to identify future capital and after-sales opportunities.
Develop and collect market knowledge. Identify and review the competition and relay this information to the Normet Sales and Service Teams.

We are looking for
A minimum of 5 years’ experience in mining and aftermarket sales support. Account Management experience is considered an advantage.
Excellence in written and verbal communication in English. Other Central and/or Northern European languages are seen as benefit.
Willingness to travel up to 75% of working time within Europe.
Experience with MS Office Suite, CRM systems, and sales analytics tools.
Budget/forecasting skills.
Capacity to operate in a demanding environment with competing priorities.
Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
An elevated level of responsiveness, organization, and interpersonal skills.
Detail orientation, financial acumen and a strong command of sales tools and account management.

Other Information
Permanent and fulltime position.
Travel up to 75% of working time within Europe. Your home office could be in Sweden, Norway or Austria.
Start: as soos as possible.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!
About The Role
As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join our DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.
Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.
In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.

Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.

Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.

Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.

Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.

Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are
We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.
You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.
AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.
We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.

Strong .NET/C# development skills.

Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.

Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.

Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.
Why join Myntro?
At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.
This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You'll be part of a team that's expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.
Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.
Interested? Welcome to apply!
Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.
For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Lema Naderi, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – lema.naderi@myntro.com 
We look forward to receiving your application!

Who are we?
Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects since 2007 – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential.
At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience.
We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
Brief Call: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris Consulting: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
Case study: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.
As every role is different, we adapt the process accordingly, always focusing on the best possible candidate experience. We look forward to meeting you!
Job description
Join Amaris Consulting as an Android Developer and contribute to a long-term project with our client in Gothenburg, within the Information System & Digital scope. You will join a product team developing and continuously improving a large-scale mobile application focused on digital customer journeys, purchasing flows, and user experience across several markets.
Your missions
Develop native Android features using Kotlin and Android SDK.
Build and improve mobile user interfaces with Jetpack Compose and XML-based UI development.
Enhance digital customer journeys and purchasing flows within a large-scale mobile application.
Integrate mobile features with APIs and backend services.
Maintain and optimize existing Android application features to support performance, reliability, and scalability.
Contribute to new development initiatives across several markets.
Collaborate with cross-functional product and development teams in an agile environment.
Analyse technical issues and implement corrective actions to improve the mobile application experience.

Your profile
Several years of experience in native Android development.
Experience working on large mobile applications with high user volumes.
Strong knowledge of Kotlin and Android SDK.
Experience with Jetpack Compose and XML-based UI development.
Experience with API integrations and backend services.
Experience with agile and cross-functional development environments.
Experience with digital purchasing flows or similar user journeys is a plus.
English fluent.
Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
Ability to collaborate effectively with product and technical teams in an international environment.

What we offer
An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities.
An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities.
A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules.
A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events, including afterworks and team buildings.
At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support.

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

Do you want to accelerate growth at an ambitious fintech company by developing marketing strategies that make a real impact? Are you someone who can both set the direction and turn ideas into action? Then the role of Senior Marketing Manager at Kustom could be the perfect opportunity for you!
About Kustom
“Kustom was born in 2024 in Stockholm, Sweden, when Klarna Checkout became so successful it earned a life of its own. Since then, we’ve grown into one of Europe’s leading checkout solutions, with a team of more than 100 people all driven by the same mission: giving every business the checkout it deserves.
We believe the best solutions aren't built in isolation. Kustom gives merchants the freedom to shape their own checkout by connecting to a growing network of 100+ partners. We handle the complexity behind the scenes, making sure every shopper enjoys the best possible experience. That way, growth happens freely, without compromises or closed loops.
Today, Kustom serves more than 24,000 merchants across 170 markets and has converted more than 25 million shoppers.”
About the role as Senior Marketing Manager
We are looking for a Senior Marketing Manager that will take ownership of a broad range of marketing initiatives across Kustom. This is a senior, individual contributor role. You should be as comfortable developing the strategy as doing the hands-on work needed to bring impactful work to life.
You will work both strategically and hands-on to turn ideas and priorities into compelling, high-impact marketing. You will collaborate across the business, develop joint initiatives with partners and lead cross-functional project teams.
In your first year, you will have established a repeatable approach to integrated go-to-market planning, led several high-priority launches or campaigns, strengthened Kustom’s merchant proposition and demonstrated measurable contribution to commercial growth.
Your initial responsibilities would include the following:
Develop insight-led marketing strategies and business cases aligned with company objectives.
Lead integrated campaigns and product launches from planning through execution.
Shape product narratives and compelling merchant propositions.
Define target audiences, segmentation, customer journeys and channel plans.
Develop joint initiatives with Sales, Product, Merchant Operations and strategic partners.
Lead cross-functional project teams and coordinate in-house specialists, PR agencies and freelancers.
Measure performance, using customer and market insights to improve results.

Your profile
We believe you have 6–8 years of broad marketing experience, ideally within B2B, SaaS, fintech, payments, or another technology-driven industry, along with a bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field. You have a strong track record of delivering impactful integrated campaigns, product launches, and go-to-market initiatives. You combine strong commercial and analytical skills with creative judgment, enabling you to turn insights into clear recommendations and guide creative, PR, and communications initiatives. You are highly self-driven, comfortable taking significant responsibility, and able to execute with speed and precision while working independently.
As a person, you thrive in a high-intensity, fast-changing environment where priorities shift and plans evolve quickly. You are equally comfortable shaping strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute, with a natural willingness to contribute wherever the team and business need you most. You enjoy working across disciplines, from product lifecycle and positioning to campaigns, partner marketing, and PR. You bring a hands-on mindset, strong communication skills, and the flexibility to take on challenges beyond your immediate responsibilities.
Requirements
6–8 years of broad marketing experience, ideally within B2B, SaaS, fintech, payments or another technology-driven industry.
A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management or a related field.
A strong track record of delivering impactful integrated campaigns, product launches and go-to-market initiatives.
Exceptional ability to work independently, manage significant responsibility and execute with speed and precision.
Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to turn insights into clear recommendations.
Strong creative judgment and experience directing creative, PR or communications work.
Excellent communication skills in English, Swedish is an advantage.

Practical details
Start: By agreement
Extent: Full-time
Location: Stockholm
Does the role as Senior Marketing Manager at Kustom sound interesting? Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We at Needo look forward to hearing from you!

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
We are currently recruiting radiographers for a well-functioning radiology department in central Sweden. 
The positions are available due to increased patient demand and upcoming retirements.
This is a long-term opportunity within a stable public healthcare provider offering modern equipment, a structured introduction programme, and a clear pathway toward Swedish professional authorization.
The department
The department consists of approximately 30 employees, including 15 radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and medical physicists. The unit operates in recently renovated facilities with newly upgraded CT, conventional X-ray, ultrasound and fluoroscopy equipment. An MRI replacement is planned.
Both acute and elective imaging are performed. The department collaborates closely with primary care, inpatient services, the emergency department, private healthcare providers, and other radiology units within the county. This ensures a varied and clinically broad workload.
Several radiographers have previously been internationally recruited and are now well established locally with their families, contributing to a supportive and inclusive working environment.
The hospital serves approximately 27,000 inhabitants locally and around 39,000 in the wider catchment area. The area offers a safe, family-friendly environment with access to schools, childcare, and extensive natural surroundings.
The role
The position includes standard duties as a licensed radiographer, primarily within:
Conventional radiography
CT
MRI (may become part of responsibilities over time)

You will work with both emergency and planned examinations.
A structured introduction programme lasting 6–12 months is provided, depending on previous experience, to ensure competence in equipment, routines, and Swedish clinical standards.
Collaboration with a nearby radiology unit (approximately 40 minutes by car) may occur. Travel takes place during working hours.
Evening standby duty is included. Approximately once per week. You are required to be on site within 30 minutes when on standby duty. Therefore, it is necessary that you either hold a valid driver’s license and have access to a car, or live within close distance of the hospital.
Requirements
Qualification in Radiography from an EU country
The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
Ability to work with CT and conventional radiography in acute and elective settings
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish – full support provided
Qualification must be eligible for recognition by the Swedish National Board of
Health and Welfare – we guide you through this application.
Valid professional registration/license in the country of qualification
Driving license/ B

Language and relocation
Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a radiography assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1. Work and language training are combined during this period, and the language education is provided and financed.
You begin working fully as a radiographer once Swedish authorization has been obtained.
Salary
During the language completion phase (50% employment as Radiography Assistant): 30,800 SEK/month gross.
Estimated net salary is approximately 24,300 SEK/month, depending on individual tax rate.

After obtaining Swedish authorization as a Radiographer: minimum 31,100 SEK/month gross.
Estimated net salary is approximately 24,500 SEK/month.

The salary after authorization is individually set and may be higher depending on experience, skills, and previous professional background.
The figures above refer to base salary. Additional compensation for standby duty, evening work, and shift-related supplements is not included in the stated amounts.
Application
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.
Submit your application today and include:
CV / résumé
Diploma and educational certificates/ Proof of professional license/registration
Motivation letter
References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

The opportunity
We’re growing — and we’re ready for the next key player in our team
At Hitachi Energy, the demand for HVDC technology is expanding rapidly, and so is our need for world-class technical training. To support our global projects and customers, we are strengthening our Valves Training organization with one more Valves Technical Trainer.
In this role, you will contribute to shaping the knowledge and competence development surrounding one of our most advanced technologies. You’ll work at the intersection of engineering, product development, and customer delivery — ensuring that training content is accurate, modern, and accessible.
We are building a strong and committed team that can fulfill and exceed the customers' expectations when it comes to product and maintenance training. If you want to be a part of this journey, don´t hesitate to send in your application.
How you'll make an impact
Make people grow by delivering HVDC Valves product and maintenance training for both customers and internal personnel — on site in Ludvika or at customer locations worldwide.
Keep the HVDC GI Valves technical training portfolio aligned with the latest product updates, R&D product development projects, and branch standards.
Develop, revise, and structure training materials, presentations, and documentation, ensuring clarity and technical accuracy.
Coordinate and schedule training activities, securing trainers, facilities, and timelines in collaboration with project and customer training teams.
Ensure the HVDC Valves Training & Certification Center is used effectively, safely, and kept up to date with the appropriate training equipment and configurations.
Represent the organization in internal and external contexts, contributing to a consistent, professional, and technically robust training offering.

Your Background
Experience in technical training, ideally with a clear industry context.
Strong ability to coordinate and plan training activities, preferably in a global, project-driven environment.
Comfortable collaborating with several technical functions to ensure training content reflects the latest product versions.
Skilled in creating and maintaining training presentations, manuals, and structured documentation.
Familiar with or can show a strong interest in learning about HVDC systems, power electronics, or industrial equipment.
A proven team player with strong leadership skills, capable of guiding groups both in training situations and during internal problem-solving activities.
Experience working in environments with strict HSE standards and commitment to safe workshop and site practices.
A structured way of working, particularly in a training context.
A willingness and ability to travel internationally to support training delivery at customer sites and other Hitachi Energy locations (travelling approximately 2–3 weeks per 6-month period).
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.
Swedish fluency is not required; however, you need to be able to communicate and make yourself understood in a professional work environment.

More About Us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual, fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
Group life insurance and additional insurances
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
Health care and wellness allowance
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 SEK/month via salary deduction)
Psychological support program
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Various trainings and education supporting employee development
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

What does it take to keep a growing renewable energy business connected, secure and ready for the future? At OX2, cloud infrastructure supports everything from daily operations and business-critical systems to data platforms and AI. We are now looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Lead to take ownership of our infrastructure landscape, shape its technical direction and ensure that our platforms support the business as it continues to develop.
YOU WILL
OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As OX2 expands its role as an independent power producer, the demand for its digital infrastructure continues to grow. Secure, reliable and well-managed cloud platforms are essential to supporting operations across different markets, as well as the company's ambitions within data and AI.
As Cloud & Infrastructure Lead, you will take overall responsibility for OX2's cloud and infrastructure environment, spanning Azure, AWS and the services connecting them. You will set technical expectations, evaluate proposed solutions and follow up on delivery. You will also work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure that infrastructure decisions support both operational needs and future digital initiatives.
Your main responsibilities will be to:

Own and develop OX2's cloud infrastructure, including Azure and AWS architecture, landing zones, standards and governance.

Set technical direction across enterprise networking, connectivity and core infrastructure services.

Oversee identity and endpoint management, Windows and Linux environments, backup and recovery.

Strengthen cloud security and operational resilience, including disaster recovery, patching and vulnerability remediation.

Drive FinOps and cloud cost optimization, improving transparency around consumption, budgets and infrastructure investments.

Manage infrastructure suppliers and managed service providers, ensuring clear responsibilities, measurable service levels and reliable delivery.

The role has a broad international scope, with close collaboration across OX2's technology organization, business stakeholders and external partners
YOU ARE 
You have a solid background in cloud and infrastructure and experience taking responsibility for complex technical environments. You understand how architecture, networking, security and operations fit together. You bring strong experience from Azure or AWS, or both, and a good understanding of enterprise networking and infrastructure architecture. You are familiar with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform, and have experience with several of the services surrounding cloud infrastructure, such as Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Windows or Linux environments, and backup and recovery.
You have worked closely with external suppliers or managed service providers and know how to set requirements, evaluate technical solutions and follow up on delivery. You also understand the financial side of infrastructure and have experience improving operational efficiency and managing cloud costs. You are comfortable making decisions and challenging established ways of working when needed. With a practical approach, you can move between detailed technical discussions and conversations with senior management, explaining not only what needs to be done but also why it matters to the business. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from the energy sector, critical infrastructure or another regulated environment is valuable, but not required.
At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence the infrastructure supporting an international renewable energy business. With broad responsibility and considerable autonomy, you will help shape the technical foundation for OX2's operations and continued development within data, AI and digital services
WANT TO KNOW MORE?
For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.
We are looking forward hearing from you!
ABOUT OX2
OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage. 
With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.

jobs.occupation: Senior Lithography & Process Development Engineer to Mycronic
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
For over 50 years, our innovative solutions have developed and manufactured machines for electronics and display manufacturing. We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing. 
In this role, you will be part of our R&D team Metrology and Process Control Group (PMCD), which currently consists of 12 team members working within pattern design, metrology, cleanliness, and data analysis.
Work tasks
Technical Project Leadership
Lead technically demanding customer demonstrations and development activities from concept to implementation.
Coordinate cross-functional activities with production, quality, metrology, R&D, suppliers, and customers.
Drive technical decisions, manage priorities and risks, and ensure successful delivery.
Mentor colleagues and contribute to the development of engineering competence within PMCD.

Lithography Process Ownership
Own and continuously improve lithography processes to ensure process capability, stability, yield, and product quality.
Define and maintain process specifications, operating procedures, and engineering standards.
Lead root-cause investigations and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Advanced Process Control (APC)
Develop and implement APC strategies using statistical methods, SPC, DOE, and other data-driven approaches.
Analyze process and metrology data to identify sources of variation and define opportunities for improvement.
Define and monitor relevant process KPIs and drive improvements in process robustness and performance.

Process Development & Technology Innovation
Lead the development and qualification of new lithography processes, materials, and equipment.
Design and execute experiments to optimize processes and support technology development.
Translate research and emerging technologies into robust, scalable manufacturing solutions.

We are looking for
This is a role for you who enjoy combining scientific understanding with practical engineering to develop robust, data-driven solutions that create long-term value. You have a structured and analytical mindset and thrive in multidisciplinary environments. You are curious, proactive, and continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, technologies, and ways of working. As you will collaborate with colleagues, suppliers, customers, and stakeholders across the organization, you are a strong team player who enjoys building relationships, fostering collaboration, and leading technical discussions to achieve common goals.
On top of that, you have:
A Masters Degree or Ph.D. in Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Electronics, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline.
At least some years of industrial experience in semiconductor manufacturing, lithography, photomask manufacturing, or another advanced manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of process engineering, process characterization, and statistical data analysis.
Experience with DOE, root-cause analysis, and systematic problem-solving methodologies.
Experience leading technical projects or coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities.
Strong knowledge in English, both written and spoken.

We see it as a merit if you have:
Experience with APC, SPC, process monitoring, and metrology systems.
Experience qualifying new processes, materials, or equipment.
Knowledge of semiconductor, photomask, or display manufacturing technologies.
Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA, or other structured continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience working with international customers and suppliers.

Additional information
Start: By agreement 
Scope: Full-time 
Location: Täby and possibility of hybrid work (but minimum 3 days per week In office as an average)

How do you design memory technology that delivers high performance while keeping power consumption and silicon area to a minimum? At Xenergic, it starts with a deep understanding of analog circuits, advanced semiconductor technology and the ability to turn complex design challenges into working solutions. We are now looking for an Analog Design Engineer to join our team in Lund and contribute to the development of our next generation of on-chip memory IP.
YOU WILL
 Xenergic is a Lund-based semiconductor company developing high-speed, low-power on-chip memory IP for advanced chip technologies. Our engineering teams work with technology that ranges from transistor-level circuit design to physical implementation, verification and integration into customers' products.  As an Analog Design Engineer, you will join a specialised engineering team developing and optimising the analog circuits behind Xenergic's memory technology. You will contribute to new designs and improvements to existing solutions, using your understanding of the broader memory architecture to guide design decisions.  Your main responsibilities will be to:

Design and optimise analog circuits and custom IC blocks for advanced SRAM and memory IP.

Work with transistor-level and schematic design, including circuit simulation and verification across different operating conditions.

Analyse circuit behaviour and optimise designs for power consumption, performance, silicon area and reliability.

Contribute to physical layout, design verification and analysis of layout-related effects, including parasitics and EMIR.

Support the development and adaptation of memory IP across different semiconductor process technologies.

Collaborate with colleagues across analog, digital, layout and verification to solve technical challenges and support integration into customer designs.

You will join an analog team of six engineers with different technical backgrounds and experience. The team holds regular technical discussions to share challenges, design decisions and possible improvements. Much of the work requires independent problem-solving, alongside close collaboration to develop the technology. Depending on the project, you may also participate in technical discussions with customers.
The position is full-time and based on-site at Xenergic's office in Lund.
YOU ARE
You hold an M.Sc. in Electronics Engineering, Microelectronics or a related field, or have gained equivalent expertise through relevant industry experience. You have at least three years of professional experience in analog IC design, including transistor-level design, schematic development and simulation.
You have a good understanding of CMOS circuit design and are comfortable analyzing simulation results and optimizing circuits for power, performance and area. You have experience with Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre or comparable EDA tools, along with an understanding of how physical layout and parasitic effects influence circuit performance.
Experience in SRAM or memory design is an advantage but not required. Knowledge of advanced technology nodes, FinFET, DRC/LVS, EMIR-aware design, silicon measurements or scripting languages such as Python, shell or SKILL would also be an advantage.
 As a person, you are curious, analytical and enjoy understanding how things work, from individual circuits to broader architecture. You take ownership of your work, enjoy solving problems independently and value collaboration with colleagues. You are comfortable working in a smaller organization where learning, flexibility and sharing knowledge are part of everyday work. Fluency in English is required.
At Xenergic, you will work alongside experienced engineers in a highly specialized environment where your ideas and technical contributions can make a real difference. You will have the opportunity to influence the development of advanced memory technology and see your work become part of products used by customers around the world
WANT TO KNOW MORE? 
In this recruitment, Xenergic is collaborating with Nexer Recruit. Applications are reviewed continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible. For questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.
We look forward to hearing from you.
ABOUT XENERGIC
Xenergic is a Swedish deep-tech semiconductor technology company based in Lund, developing high-speed and low-power on-chip memory IP for advanced semiconductor applications. Its technology addresses important challenges in modern chip design, where performance, power consumption and silicon area are becoming increasingly important. Xenergic's solutions are relevant for applications ranging from IoT and mobile devices to networking, high-performance computing and AI.

TL;DR — You'll make sure no one at Lovable spends time on anything AI can do. We're defining how AI-native companies operate internally, across Product, GTM, and G&A. You'll own the systems that let a 300-person team move like a 3,000-person company: workflow automations, internal AI tools, data enrichment pipelines. You'll use Lovable itself to build much of this. This role is part of Project Automate Lovable, working closely with our AI Operations & Automation function and FBOS team.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
Shipped production automations at a company: You've built workflow systems at scale that ran without you. Actual business-critical automations used by teams.
Engineering brain, modern toolkit: You understand how systems actually work (APIs, databases, architecture) and can review code confidently. You move fast by choosing the right tool for the job: AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code etc) when they're faster, no-code (Lovable itself, n8n, Clay, etc.) when it fits, raw code when it's needed.
Data is part of your building material: You can turn fragmented data across tools, databases, and external sources into reliable, usable systems. You’re comfortable designing data models, writing complex SQL, building enrichment and transformation pipelines, and creating the feedback loops that keep data trustworthy over time.
AI tool obsessed: You're always testing the latest models, apps, and workflows before anyone else. You've deployed internal AI tools (Claude/ChatGPT with custom contexts, AI agents, MCPs, etc.) at a company and you're constantly experimenting with new ones.
Can't unsee inefficiency: You see the whole company as one machine. Once you spot a broken process, you can't leave it alone.
High agency: You don't wait for permission. You find the bottleneck, build the fix, and ship it.

What you’ll do
Own internal AI systems that make Lovable run faster than it should.
Define how AI-native companies operate: Help build the playbook. What we learn here scales to every company using Lovable.
Build internal tools and workflows: Using Lovable, AI agents, no-code, raw code—whatever gets the job done fastest. Lovable on Lovable first, always.
Turn company data into operational leverage: Connect and enrich data across our stack, then put it directly to work, powering automations, internal tools, AI agents, decision-making, and proactive workflows across Finance, Business Operations, Legal, etc.
Deploy AI agent armies: Claude/ChatGPT with MCPs configured so every teammate has AI working for them, not the other way around.
Squeeze value from our stack: Make the AI features in Slack, Linear, Notion, Ashby, etc. actually deliver.
Level up the team: Turn everyone at Lovable into AI power users. Document what works. Scale it.
Own it end-to-end: You build it, you maintain it, you improve it.

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.occupation: Finance Business Partner - Northern Europe to KUKA Nordic
jobs.description:
KUKA Nordic is looking for an experienced Finance Business Partner to support the Northern Europe organisation across the Nordics, Baltics, the UK and Ireland. This is a broad regional role where you will combine financial expertise with business partnering, working closely with senior stakeholders to strengthen financial performance, governance and business decision-making.  If you are motivated by combining financial expertise with commercial impact, KUKA Nordic offers the opportunity to make a real difference across Northern Europe.

ABOUT THE ROLE
As Finance Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting KUKA's Northern Europe organisation across the Nordics, Baltics, the UK and Ireland. As a member of the Northern Europe leadership team, you will combine financial expertise with commercial insight to support business decisions, strengthen financial governance and drive business performance across the region.
While transactional accounting and statutory reporting are managed by KUKA's Shared Service Center in Hungary, you will have the regional financial responsibility and act as the key link between the business, the SSC and Group Finance. Acting as a trusted Finance Business Partner to the Northern Europe leadership team and Country Managers.

Supporting strategic and commercial decision-making through financial analysis, business cases and performance insights.

Leading budgeting, forecasting, performance management, and KPI follow-up across the region.

Driving financial governance and ensuring high-quality financial reporting in collaboration with the Shared Service Center.

Coordinating audits, statutory compliance, tax matters and external stakeholders across multiple countries.

Monitoring working capital, cash flow and overall financial performance while identifying opportunities to improve business results.

Driving continuous improvements to finance processes and strengthening collaboration across the regional finance organisation.

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a passion for supply chain excellence, product introductions and supplier collaboration? Join Ascom in Gothenburg and play an important role in ensuring that our products are introduced and manufactured with the right quality, capacity and efficiency.

As our Project Manager within Supply Chain, you will manage global supply chain projects from initial scope and planning through execution, follow-up and handover to the maintenance phase.
You will coordinate activities between main project and across Supply Chain, Quality, Purchasing, Logistics, R&D and other relevant functions, while working closely with our EMS and ODM suppliers. A key part of the role is ensuring that new products and manufacturing processes meet Ascom’s requirements regarding quality, capacity, cost, flexibility and lead time. The position is based at our office in Gothenburg and includes international collaboration and frequent travel to supplier sites.

Your responsibilities

Plan, lead and follow up supply chain projects, including scope, timelines, deliverables, risks and reporting.

Ensure quality assurance and on-time delivery throughout the project lifecycle.

Coordinate product introductions and secure a smooth transition into ramp-up, mass production and the maintenance phase.

Ensure that products are manufactured and repaired according to Ascom’s requirements for quality, capacity and lead time.

Manage project progress with EMS and ODM suppliers, including cost, quality management plans, yield, capacity, efficiency and pre-series activities.

Confirm that manufacturing processes and deliveries are developed, validated and ready for implementation.

Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Coordinate activities across Supply Chain, Quality, Purchasing, Logistics, R&D, Marketing and other relevant functions.

Support the continuous improvement and standardization of supply chain project methods, processes and ways of working.

Contribute to a stable, secure and continuously improving global supply chain. 

What you bring

A master’s degree in mechanical engineering, electronic engineering or a related technical field.

Several years of experience within Supply Chain, Manufacturing and/or Quality Assurance.

Proven experience leading projects and cross-functional project teams.

Strong knowledge of project management methods, planning, risk management and stakeholder coordination.

Strong understanding of electronic manufacturing processes, production flow, test methods and industrialization.

Experience working with external manufacturing partners, preferably EMS or ODM suppliers.

Experience and strong knowledge in translating technical requirements into clear manufacturing, supplier and quality deliverables.

A good understanding of electronic manufacturing processes, including production, testing, logistics, purchasing and quality assurance.

Experience building and developing strong, long-term supplier relationships.

Who you are
You are a structured, proactive and technically skilled Project Manager with a strong understanding of production processes, engineering drawings and technical specifications. You can quickly identify gaps, clarify requirements and drive practical solutions together with suppliers and internal teams. You have strong technical skills, communicate clearly, build trust with suppliers and colleagues, and know how to influence decisions without relying on formal authority. Why join Ascom?

Work in a global and cross-functional environment.

Collaborate with experienced colleagues and international suppliers.

Influence how new products are introduced and manufactured.

Contribute directly to supply chain quality, stability and performance.

Develop your expertise through challenging projects and continuous learning. 

Ready to join us?
If you are ready to take ownership of complex supply chain projects and contribute to the successful introduction of Ascom’s products, we would be happy to hear from you. Apply today and help us shape a reliable, efficient and future-ready supply chain.

Ascom is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone is treated fairly and has the opportunity to succeed.

A role where your decisions directly impact employees, sponsors, and business success.

jobs.occupation: Executive Chef till Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description:
A breakfast that starts the day right, a conference lunch that gets people talking, and a banquet that becomes part of the memory.
 
At Sheraton Stockholm, food is part of how we bring people together. With 463 rooms and 14 meeting rooms in the heart of the city, we welcome guests from around the world for stays, meetings and celebrations. As our hotel enters its next chapter, we’re looking for an Executive Chef to shape the culinary experience across breakfast, meetings, events and banqueting.
 
This is a role for someone who enjoys the scale and energy of a large international hotel. Someone who brings creativity to the menu, confidence to the operation and care to the way they lead. 
 
Join us and set the flavour of Sheraton Stockholm.
 
Big occasions and everyday details
You’ll take culinary ownership of these operations, setting the direction for the food and leading the kitchen organisation behind it. From the breakfast buffet to a working lunch or a large evening event, you’ll make sure every offering has a clear identity and delivers on taste, presentation and service.
 
You know that cooking at scale takes imagination and precision. You’ll develop seasonal menus and food experiences that suit different occasions, guest needs and budgets, while keeping execution consistent. Working closely with F&B and Events, you’ll turn each brief into an experience that works for the guest, the kitchen and the business.
 
You’ll also keep the operation moving forward: refining our breakfast offering, strengthening our meeting and event menus, and finding fresh ways to make hotel dining feel generous, relevant and memorable.
 
Lead the people and own the performance
Great food starts with a team that knows where it’s going. You’ll lead, coach and develop the kitchen leadership team and wider culinary organisation, building a culture of pride, collaboration and accountability. Clear expectations, constructive feedback and opportunities to grow will be part of everyday life in your kitchen.
 
You’ll take an active role in recruitment and talent development, building the skills and confidence needed to deliver across a demanding operation. You plan ahead, stay present during service and create structure that helps people perform at their best.
 
Commercial ownership comes with the role. You’ll manage food cost, recipe costing, purchasing, inventories and waste, translating financial and operational insights into practical improvements. You’ll balance staffing and productivity with a sustainable working environment, develop strong supplier relationships and maintain high standards of food safety, hygiene and compliance with Marriott requirements.
 
You’ll work closely with F&B, Events, Operations, Finance and the wider hotel leadership team, bringing a clear culinary perspective to shared decisions.
 
Bring your experience and your appetite for what’s next
You’re an experienced culinary leader with a strong background in upscale or luxury hotels, ideally as an Executive Chef, Executive Sous Chef or in a comparable senior role. You understand high-volume breakfast, meetings and banqueting, and have a track record of delivering quality across several services and events at once.
 
You’re confident developing menus and equally comfortable discussing food cost, staffing and operational performance. You spot opportunities, make thoughtful decisions and follow through. Your leadership is grounded and approachable, with high standards and a genuine investment in the people around you.
 
International experience is highly valued. We welcome the perspective and ideas it brings, alongside curiosity about our guests and the market we operate in. You communicate fluently in English, and Swedish or experience from the Nordic market is an advantage. You must have the right to work in Sweden.
 
Make your mark on an iconic Stockholm hotel
Sheraton Stockholm has been a meeting place since 1971. Now, with a major hotel transformation and fresh momentum, there’s an opportunity to build on that heritage and shape what comes next.
 
You’ll have room to influence the food, strengthen the operation and develop a team that takes pride in every service, from the first breakfast guest to the final course of the evening.
